This sheet mixes two physically different systems in one plan view: (1) RC ring/tie beams RB1/RB2/RB3, printed as marked box sections with real grid positions and cross-referenced to S-03's rebar specs, and (2) an overlaid steel roof structure (จันทัน rafter, แป purlin, อกไก่ ridge, ตั้ง strut) described only by generic material-spec leader callouts with no individual member marks. RB1/RB2/RB3 are recorded as atomic grid-positioned beam elements below (high-to-moderate confidence); the steel members are recorded as spec-level descriptive entries without individual grid_ref, following the same approach as other houses in this series' rafter/ridge callouts — recording member type+spec, not tracing every repeated line's own position.

RB2 rows sit AT the main grid lines (row A and row B) — read from the 'ตั้ง' (strut) callout leader pointing to a short vertical member connecting the unlabeled ridge line down to the RB2 line at row A, implying RB2 is the wall-top ring beam, not an edge/overhang member. Moderate confidence; not independently cross-checked against an elevation view (out of op04 scope).

The roof's true 3-D shape (ridge position relative to the ring beam, hip vs gable geometry) is NOT fully resolved — the ridge (อกไก่) and the far eave edge sit beyond row A / row B by dimensioned but unlabeled amounts (see grid-master unassigned_dimensions); recorded อกไก่'s x-extent as an approximation across grid1-grid4 (its true extent may include the 0.50m x-overhangs, not confirmable from this sheet alone) — flagged low confidence rather than asserted.

RB3 (short header beam near the 'Cx' stair/porch opening, matching the same local mark used on both floor beam plans) has the same un-dimensioned 'Cx' position ambiguity noted on the floor beam plans.
